title: Runner image smoke and release/config documentation review
summary: Checks whether the actual QA runner image includes the targeted image updates before using provider requests to assess them. Separately reviews configuration and release documentation against observed behavior without treating missing artifacts as a runtime pass.
prerequisites: Record QA relay source SHA, image digest and tested QA Docker runner image digest and inspect its published build provenance; do not assume latest example image is used by QA template.
Have read-only access to rendered source revision docs/config example and release notes. No release publishing or production image change is authorized.
Q01 healthy turns available on both providers; if either provider unavailable mark its runtime subcheck blocked.

variants.title: Image-consumption gated provider smoke
variants.summary: Checks the exact QA runner image and installed provider versions before attributing image updates to a test. Only updates present in that image are eligible for a Claude and Cursor request check; absent updates and unavailable providers must not be reported as passed.

steps.action: Read QA template version and its image digest, resolve digest to immutable build/provenance, and compare example image updates #91,#95,#98,#108,#111,#114,#116,#120,#140 with exact tested image; record installed Claude and Cursor CLI version strings, never assume them from a tag.
steps.expected: Digest, provenance and installed CLI versions recorded; each image-only PR classified covered only if tested image actually incorporates it, otherwise not-applicable-to-image.
steps.evidence: Template/version UUID, immutable digest, provenance/source SHA and nonsecret version output.

steps.action: If image incorporates the targeted bumps, use Q01-approved QA queues to run one benign unique-ID turn per provider and poll successful build/response.
steps.expected: Both provider turns complete on the pinned observed image with successful build and connected runner; if image lacks bump, do not claim those PRs passed.
steps.evidence: Redacted session/workspace/build IDs, CLI versions and response success flag.

cleanup: End only these disposable QA sessions and verify normal reap or record authorized cleanup; leave image pins unchanged.

variants.title: Docs and release tooling non-runtime inspection
variants.summary: Checks that the recorded source's configuration and credential-lifetime documentation agree with observed QA behavior, and that available release output groups breaking changes as expected. A missing release artifact blocks that part of the review and does not count as runtime success.

steps.action: At recorded relay origin/main SHA compare README, configuration reference, config.example.yaml and rendered release notes/artifacts against observed Q01-Q09 behavior; check #109 credential lifetime wording and #129 breaking-change grouping; treat #126/#139 as covered only through runtime/config smoke where built.
steps.expected: No contradicted config names/defaults or credential-lifetime claims; breaking changes grouped as expected in generated release output if artifact exists. Missing release artifact is blocked review, not runtime success.
steps.evidence: Source SHA, file paths/revision, sanitized comparison results and any mismatch IDs.

cleanup: No runtime resources created; record doc/release mismatch for follow-up without publishing changes.

notes: Documentation/release commits do not imply a synthetic runtime test; review only against the actually tested revision.
Mark unsupported build/features not-in-build; these case definitions are proposals, not executed results.
